items.control: Enable strong multi-factor authentication and review active account sessions.
items.verification_step: Confirm MFA is enabled on the intended account and review the account security/session page for unexpected sessions.

items.control: Reduce unnecessary public profile exposure and review audience settings.
items.verification_step: Re-open the relevant privacy/audience settings and confirm only intentionally public information remains visible.

items.control: Agree on a consent-based trusted support and escalation plan.
items.verification_step: Confirm the agreed trusted contact and appropriate platform safety/reporting channels are understood by the participants.
